items.title: 3DS 2.4: draft, not a mandate
items.content_text: Preview, pending Avi’s review. EMVCo reports that draft Protocol and Core Functions v2.4 is available for Associate and Subscriber review. No global migration deadline is asserted. Who: 3DS servers, SDK providers and authentication teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.emvco.com/news-publications/emvco-newsletter-q3-2026/

items.title: 3DS approvals: conditional extension
items.content_text: Preview, pending Avi’s review. EMVCo’s Q3 update reports conditional approval extensions for eligible products intending to migrate to v2.4.0.0. Confirm product-specific eligibility. Who: 3DS product providers. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.emvco.com/news-publications/emvco-newsletter-q3-2026/

items.title: Agentic payments: intent framework draft
items.content_text: Preview, pending Avi’s review. EMVCo’s draft framework introduces Intent Services for consumer-authorised intent. It is a specification-development step, not a deployed network mandate. Who: Agentic checkout and payment product teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.emvco.com/news-publications/emvco-newsletter-q3-2026/
